title: Add image OCR and vision pipeline

context.summary: Route image OCR and vision captioning through @mindory/llm and persist searchable OCR/caption/label artifacts.
context.background: The image extractor currently provides deterministic metadata and embedded PNG text fallback. TASK-77 makes configured local HTTP OCR and vision calls real through the central LLM SDK.

in: Expose a local-http vision captioning provider from @mindory/llm.
Wire OCR and vision providers into the image semantic extractor.
Persist OCR text, captions, analysis and labels as derived artifacts/spans.
Add integration coverage with a fake local OCR/vision provider.
Update docs and validators for image OCR/vision support.
out: Object detection bounding boxes beyond labels/caption text.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm exposes a local-http vision caption provider when vision-captioning is enabled.
Image OCR calls @mindory/llm OCR when OCR is enabled.
Image vision captioning calls POST /vision/caption through @mindory/llm.
Image OCR/caption/labels are searchable through artifact/document search with source refs.
Disabled OCR/vision remains non-blocking and fallback extraction still works.

manual_checks: Confirm RAW image objects remain immutable and model output is derived state.

risks: Image model calls must remain inside @mindory/llm.
Required model failures must surface clearly without corrupting fallback metadata.
Experimental image roles must still require explicit experimental mode.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
